sections.heading: Repairs, tune-ups and good used bikes.
Who we are
paragraphs: Quarry Street Bikes is a made-up neighbourhood bike shop: flat fixes while you wait, proper tune-ups, and a rack of good used bikes out front.
It isn't real — it's the demo of the plain business site Patchlamp builds. Text a change (“we're closed Monday”, “add e-bike repairs”) and watch it land here.
